item.title: What is considered a “real” house to you?
item.description: Our home (in New Orleans) is an off site built house. Two halves shipped from two states away, joined, placed and bolted to a raised platform. It was constructed (wood frame) in a warehouse to spec and built to survive transport. It’s outer walls are 50% thicker than code. The central wall is 8in thick. The roof has multipoint supports withhurricane ties. It has survived five hurricanes without damage. I would put my manufactured home up against 90% of the ones in my area.
